title: Today Jesus Calls You to Come to Him
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner reminds us that no matter who we are or where we've been, God's love is available to us. He shares a message of hope and redemption, challenging listeners to come to Christ and receive His forgiveness and peace, no matter what struggles they may be facing. Whether you're seeking peace from anxiety, healing from depression, or simply assurance of your salvation, Pastor Chris Zehner's words are sure to inspire and uplift.
